decision.reason: Reuters described the merchant-vessel sinking and the Syria–IMO/Bulgaria investigation request; maritime safety incident reporting has an identifiable document-and-follow-up workflow.

opportunities.idea_name: Black Sea Vessel Incident Evidence Casebook
opportunities.core_job: Keep auditable incident and search-and-rescue evidence after merchant vessel attacks
opportunities.target_customer: Black Sea shipowners, P&I correspondents and vessel risk teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-provided vessel, incident date, crew status, authorities, documents and follow-up actions with source-linked timeline, open questions and human closure approval
opportunities.why_now: Reuters on 8 October reported Syria requesting IMO and Bulgarian investigation after Alfa Watan sank; unknown attacker and unresolved crew search make traceable non-speculative incident evidence necessary.
opportunities.before_state: Official statements, crew information and insurers' correspondence are fragmented.
opportunities.after_state: Single dated incident dossier with source references, outstanding questions, owners and review
opportunities.source_evidence_kind: original article / verified primary or publisher report read
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: Browser-native deterministic workflow with manually imported data; validation pending
